# AgentBridge Atlas API

> China data & services, bought by machines or people.
> No accounts. No subscriptions. No API keys. Pay per item in USDC on Base via x402.

Base URL: https://api.060504.shop
Wallet: 0x1630c8E0833c367F39f0ca909b6b67f5159d7A00 (Base mainnet)
Payment: x402 v2, USDC on Base (EIP-3009, no gas for payer)

## Discovery Endpoints (free, no payment)

GET / — Service homepage (HTML)
GET /health — Health check (200 OK)
GET /openapi.json — Full OpenAPI 3.0 spec (JSON)
GET /.well-known/x402 — x402 payment configuration (JSON)
GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json — MCP server identity card (JSON)
GET /robots.txt — Crawling rules
GET /llms.txt — This file

## API Endpoints (x402 paid)

### Web Fetch — raw content
POST /v1/fetch/dynamic
  Fetch any Chinese webpage, return clean Markdown or HTML.
  Price: x402 flat $0.008 per fetch
  Input: {url: string, output_format: "markdown"|"html"}
  Output: text/plain
  Tags: raw-content

## How x402 Payment Works

1. Call any paid endpoint with GET → receive 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header
2. Decode the header (base64 x402 v2 PaymentRequired)
3. Sign an EIP-3009 transfer for the exact amount in USDC on Base
4. Retry the request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
5. Server verifies on-chain → returns 200 with content

All prices are in USDC (6 decimals). Examples:
  $0.01 = 10000 units
  $0.008 = 8000 units
  $4.99 = 4990000 units
  $90 = 90000000 units

## Asset Metadata (free)

GET /v1/assets/{asset_id} — Returns id, name, kind, price, currency, payment method, content URL
GET /v1/assets/{asset_id}/content — Returns 402 challenge (GET) / delivers content after payment (POST)
